subject: How to modify web page title name

messages.author: a81c72df1c8fe3c3
messages.subject: How to modify web page title name
parts: I am using R Shiny to build an application and wonder if there is an easy way to customize the web page title bar as below. Thanks!

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: How to modify web page title name
parts:
There are many ways you can change the title. If you're using `fluidPage` or `fixedPage`, the easiest way is to simply provide the `title` argument.

Example:

runApp(shinyApp(
  ui = fluidPage(
    title = "my title",
    "page content"
  ),
  server = function(input, output, session) {
    
  }
))


You can also manually add a <title> tag to the header by adding `tags$head(tags$title("my title"))` in the UI, but the above is easier
